srs: The museum tickets system records Visitor, Ticket, TicketService, and Exhibition; each has an id attribute. Each Visitor can have zero or more Ticket records, and each Ticket belongs to exactly one Visitor. Each Ticket uses exactly one TicketService, and each TicketService serves zero or more Ticket records. Each TicketService manages one or more Exhibition records by composition, and each Exhibition belongs to exactly one TicketService. Each Visitor can reference zero or more Exhibition records, and each Exhibition can be referenced by zero or more Visitor records.
